# Grein

> Grein is a multi-tenant master data management (MDM) platform. Each workspace defines entity types (e.g. company, product) with typed fields; records get values from several sources (e.g. crm, erp), which Grein merges into golden records (the `merged` source). Data is read and written through a REST API (`/api/v1`, API key as Bearer token) and read by reporting tools through an OData v4 feed (`/odata/v1`).

Notes for AI coding assistants building integrations:

- Each workspace has its own, typed OpenAPI 3.0 description at `GET https://<grein address>/api/v1/openapi.json` (needs an API key). It lists the workspace's entity types, fields, data types, required and unique fields and sources. Prefer it over guessing field names. A generic description, without workspace fields, is at `/api/openapi.json`.
- Write to the integration's own source, usually with the batch upsert `PUT /api/v1/{entityType}` (matched on the entity type's unique fields). `merged` and `manual` can't be written through the API.
- Read changes with `?since=` and follow `page` up to `totalPages`. On 429 or 503, wait `Retry-After` seconds and retry.
- Read the API key from the environment; never hard-code it.

## API and integrations

- [The REST API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/api.md): endpoints, parameters, value formats, upsert, incremental sync, errors, rate limits, OpenAPI descriptions
- [Building integrations with AI tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/ai-integrations.md): how to give an AI assistant what it needs, and keep data safe
- [Configuring API keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/api-keys.md): creating keys, sensitivity levels, rotation
- [The OData feed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/odata.md): read-only OData v4 for Power BI, Fabric and Excel; $filter, $select, paging

## Concepts

- [Master data management terminology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/terminology.md): golden record, survivorship, sources and other terms
- [Entity types and fields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/entities-and-fields.md): field types, required and unique fields, references, retention
- [Sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/sources.md): where data comes from, source priority, the merged and manual sources
- [Merging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/merging.md): how values from sources are merged, survivorship rules
- [Validation, transformations and API lookups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/validation-and-lookups.md): how values are cleaned and checked on write, deferred validation errors
- [Sensitivity labels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grein-mdm/docs/main/guide/sensitivity.md): which fields users and API keys can see
